chains.typical_hours_note_en: LOW confidence, third-party only (not from Panda). Deal/mall directories list Riyadh Panda Hyper branches as 08:00-01:00 daily; hours vary by branch and format, and Ramadan differs. Verify per branch.
chains.notes: Official site panda.com.sa is behind a Vercel Security Checkpoint (HTTP 429 to curl and WebFetch), so nothing official was read; the locator URL was only seen as a search-result link, not loaded. typical_hours comes from two third-party pages: dealzsaudi.com lists 20 Riyadh branches (18 Panda Hyper, 2 Panda) all with the identical text 'Daily from 8:00 am until 1:00 am' (looks like a template, undated), and getoccupi.com lists HyperPanda Al Maather Square 2 as 8:00 AM - 1:00 AM. Unloaded search snippets disagree for some branches (Waze: Panda Al Yasmin Mall 09:00-01:00; ilofo: Al Rimal Center 07:00-01:00, Fri 08:00-00:30), and no source confirmed any 24-hour Riyadh branch. customer_phone and name_ar are from third-party pages / Panda careers-site titles seen in search results, not from a loaded official page. No branch records were written for this chain.

chains.typical_hours_note_en: Official store locator lists every branch as 07:00-02:00 on all seven days, Friday included (no prayer-time closure shown). Ramadan hours are not covered by the locator.
chains.notes: Per-branch data (name, address, lat/lng, OpenHours per weekday, phone) is embedded in the locator page's Next.js RSC payload as 'initialStores' (419 entries nationwide); Arabic at /ar/store-locator, English at /store-locator with cookie NEXT_LOCALE=en (/en/... 301-redirects). All 419 entries carry the same hours (00:00-02:00, 07:00-23:59), including the head office and the training academy, so the value is a chain-wide default rather than individually verified; branch confidence is therefore 'medium'. Formats included under this chain: 'متجر العثيم' (Supermarket), 'ركن العثيم' (City Market / corner store) and 'العثيم اكسبرس' (Express). English branch names/addresses on the official site are machine-translated. district fields left null (the site only gives coarse, sometimes wrong, regions such as 'East Riyadh').

chains.typical_hours_note_en: Official Othaim locator gives its wholesale branches the same 07:00-02:00 daily hours as every other Othaim entry; this is a chain-wide default, so individual wholesale branches may differ.
chains.notes: Not a separate website: these are the entries typed 'الجملة' (wholesale) in the Othaim locator (14 nationwide, 6 in Riyadh) plus the one Riyadh 'Othaim Cash & Carry' entry (Khurais Rd). name_ar is assembled from the official Arabic labels 'العثيم' + 'الجملة'; the site itself only labels the type 'الجملة'. Two Riyadh wholesale entries (store IDs 303 and 121, Hijaz St) sit about 70 m apart and are probably the same store listed twice.

chains.typical_hours_note_en: Official locator lists 26 of the 29 Riyadh stores captured here as '24 Hours'; the rest have shorter hours (see branches). The locator gives one range per store with no weekday/Friday breakdown and no Ramadan hours.
chains.notes: Per-branch data (name, id, lat/lon, address, phone, hours) is embedded in the locator HTML as <option class="tm-store" data-*> attributes (121 entries, 56 under Riyadh). Captured: the S-coded supermarkets plus the public Tamimi Express on Khurais Rd (E200). Not captured: 26 other E-coded Riyadh entries, which are small outlets inside residential compounds or corporate sites (several labelled 'STRBKS'), and S159 'Fal Center', which duplicates S133's coordinates. The site's Arabic mode does not translate branch names, so branch name_ar values are my own translations of district/road names (flagged name_ar_translated) or null where unsure; the chain's Arabic name is from shop.tamimimarkets.com/ar.

chains.typical_hours_note_en: LOW confidence, third-party only (not from LuLu). Conservative range that every listing agrees on; most Riyadh branches are listed as closing at 01:00 instead (daily, or Wed-Sat only). Varies by branch; Ramadan differs.
chains.notes: All official LuLu hosts refused the request (luluhypermarket.com and gcc.luluhypermarket.com: 403 Cloudflare; lulugroupinternational.com redirects to luluretail.com: 403), so the locator URL is unverified and nothing official was read. Third-party leads: dealzsaudi.com lists 6 Riyadh branches - Al Murabba (Riyadh Avenue Mall), Al Batha, Khurais Rd (Al Nahda), Al Yasmin (The Roof Mall), Al Yarmouk (Atyaf Mall) all 'Daily from 8:00 am until 1:00 am', and Al Malaz 'Daily from 8:00 am to 12:00 am' (undated). almaal.org (10 Feb 2026) gives the Khurais Rd branch as Sun-Tue 08:00-24:00, Wed-Sat 08:00-01:00. A LuLu Retail press release seen only as a search snippet says the Sahara Mall Express store runs 08:00-01:00 daily. Newer Riyadh stores (Tuwaiq/Asal Center Oct 2025, Suwaidi flagship Mar 2026, Laban Square) had no hours in any source. customer_phone and name_ar come from third-party pages. No listing showed a 24-hour Riyadh branch. No branch records were written for this chain.

chains.typical_hours_note_en: LOW confidence, third-party only (not from Carrefour). One deals directory lists 9 of 10 Riyadh branches with this pattern; mall-based stores may follow mall hours. Ramadan and public-holiday hours differ.
chains.notes: carrefourksa.com store-finder returns HTTP 200 with a 53-byte empty page from Akamai for both a normal request and one XHR-style JSON request, and the help-centre page timed out, so nothing official was read. Third-party leads: wowdeals.me lists 10 Riyadh branches (Al Khayma Mall, Granada Mall, Cenomi Tala Mall, Flamingo Park, Al Qasr Mall, Sondos Landmark Mall, Wadi Square, Riyadh Park, Wajd Business Center: Sat-Wed 8:30 AM-12 AM, Thu-Fri 8:30 AM-1 AM; Al Quds Plaza: every day 8:30 AM-1 AM), undated; getoccupi.com lists Carrefour Cordoba Boulevard as 8:30 AM - 1:00 AM. customer_phone is from wowdeals, not Carrefour. No Carrefour wholesale format and no Makro stores were found in Riyadh (searches returned nothing for either). No listing showed a 24-hour Riyadh branch. No branch records were written for this chain.

chains.typical_hours_note_en: Most Riyadh stores list 07:00-01:00 every day including Friday. Mall stores (Panorama, Hayat) list 08:00-01:00; Al Badiyah, Irqa and Al Ageeg Square list 07:00-02:00. The locator shows no Friday prayer break and no Ramadan schedule.
chains.notes: Per-branch hours, coordinates, address and phone are in the locator HTML as data attributes (74 entries nationally, many of them Express/Regular delivery variants of one store). 18 physical Riyadh stores after merging by coordinates. Arabic branch names exist for only some entries.

chains.typical_hours_note_en: No BinDawood-branded Riyadh store could be confirmed. The bindawood.sa locator does list Riyadh entries, but every one sits at the same coordinates as a Danube store (same holding company, shared online platform), with the same 07:00-01:00 / 08:00-01:00 hours.
chains.notes: Locator is the same template as Danube (59 entries incl. disabled and a test row). No branches recorded for Riyadh to avoid duplicating Danube stores. If OSM has a BinDawood in Riyadh, hours are unknown.

chains.typical_hours_note_en: The chain site lists branches (address, phone) but no opening hours.
chains.notes: Branch coordinates come from the Google My Map embedded on the site (80 placemarks, 7 in Riyadh). Hours not confirmed from any source.

chains.typical_hours_note_en: Hours differ per store; use branches[]. Riyadh stores open between 06:00 and 08:00 and close between 24:00 and 02:00; two list a slightly different Friday. No Friday prayer closure is listed.
chains.notes: The store page calls a public JSON API (POST, country > locality > stores) with working_hours per store. 7 stores under the Riyadh locality; the Al Kharj store is outside the requested box and was dropped. The API returned no Arabic text, so name_ar is a transliteration.

chains.typical_hours_note_en: No official hours found.
chains.notes: No working official Al Sadhan website was found (alsadhan.com and variants did not resolve). Al Sadhan Group holds the SPAR licence for Saudi Arabia (SPAR International, 2018), and spar.sa serves images from an "alsadhanimages" storage account, so some former Al Sadhan stores may now trade as SPAR. Arabic name taken from Arabic job-listing titles, not from a chain page.

chains.typical_hours_note_en: No hours published on the chain site.
chains.notes: Site is a single-page app; its bundle carries no branch list and mentions Riyadh only in a privacy-policy address, so no Riyadh branch could be confirmed. Al Raya is mainly a western and southern region chain.

chains.typical_hours_note_en: No official hours found for the Riyadh stores.
chains.notes: No reachable official site (manuelmarket.com did not resolve). Argaam (2 March 2025) reports 11 branches, two in Riyadh: Mercato Mall and Park Avenue Mall, and a non-binding MoU for Al Othaim to buy 51% of the operator. A third-party listing gives 06:00-02:00 for a Jeddah store only.

chains.typical_hours_note_en: 16 of 21 listed Riyadh outlets show 09:00-22:00 daily. Outlets inside campuses and offices (PNU food court, Digital City, GACA, Yamamah University) keep office hours and close on Friday.
chains.notes: spar.sa is the "SPAR Express KSA" site; its /api/store endpoint returns 21 Riyadh outlets with per-day hours, Arabic and English names and coordinates. They are convenience outlets in hospitals, metro stations, the airport and campuses. The large SPAR supermarkets reported in 2018 do not appear, and many rows carry the same default 09:00-22:00, so treat hours for hospital and metro outlets as indicative.

chains.typical_hours_note_en: Hours come only from an undated third-party blog (Bayut "صيدليات الرياض", reader comments from 2022); treat as a lead, not a confirmed schedule. Hours vary by branch and some Nahdi branches are reported as 24-hour, but none could be confirmed.
chains.notes: No usable web locator: /en-sa/store-locator returns 404 although the site config still carries store_locator settings (pickup, drive-thru, scan and go). The branch finder appears to live in the app only. No Riyadh branches captured.

chains.typical_hours_note_en: Hours come only from an undated third-party blog (Bayut "صيدليات الرياض", reader comments from 2022); treat as a lead, not a confirmed schedule.
chains.notes: Locator blocked: al-dawaa.com answered 403 (Cloudflare "Attention Required") to a plain request and to a second fetch, so nothing was pulled. A search snippet gives the unified number 8002444444; not verified on a chain page.

chains.typical_hours_note_en: Most common pattern among Riyadh street stores (14 of 54 with hours). 12 Riyadh stores show 07:00-07:00 daily, read as 24 hours. Mall stores follow mall hours, mostly 09:00-24:00 or 09:00-01:00. Several stores open at 13:00 on Friday. Use branches[] rather than this default.
chains.notes: Open JSON endpoint behind the store page: 107 stores nationally, 58 public stores in Riyadh (distribution centre dropped), with a 7-day store_hours array (index 0 = Monday, confirmed from the page script). Four newer stores have no hours yet.

chains.typical_hours_note_en: The contact page of lemon.sa states working hours "all week, 24/7". It does not say whether that covers every branch or only the online service, and there are no per-branch hours. Unconfirmed at branch level.
chains.notes: Branch list (131 nationally, 43 in Riyadh) is embedded in the home page script for the pickup map: Arabic name, Arabic address, coordinates. The English page serves the same Arabic names, so name_en is null.

chains.typical_hours_note_en: Hours come only from an undated third-party blog (Bayut "صيدليات الرياض", reader comments from 2022); treat as a lead, not a confirmed schedule.
chains.notes: No official website or locator found (kunoozpharmacy.com and similar domains did not resolve). A Riyadh business directory describes it as a Riyadh chain founded in 1999.

chains.typical_hours_note_en: Both Riyadh stores are in malls and follow mall hours; Friday opens at 14:00.
chains.notes: Public REST endpoint behind the locator: 27 rows for Saudi Arabia but only 5 carry a Boots store code; the other 22 (numeric codes, split-shift hours, including one in south-west Riyadh) look like third-party collection points and were left out. Riyadh: Riyadh Park and Granada Mall only.

chains.typical_hours_note_en: The chain site lists branches and map links but no opening hours.
chains.notes: Riyadh-only chain (the site says 35 branches). 33 branches captured with Arabic address; coordinates were read from the Google Maps short link next to each branch.

chains.typical_hours_note_en: Hours come only from an undated third-party blog (Bayut "صيدليات الرياض", reader comments from 2022); treat as a lead, not a confirmed schedule. The chain locator itself has an empty schedule field for every branch seen.
chains.notes: Locator is reachable (Amasty store locator, JSON at /amlocator/index/ajax/, 10 branches per page with coordinates, Arabic city and district) but "schedule" is null on every row and a distance filter was ignored, so pulling Riyadh would take dozens of paged requests for no hours. Not pulled. Arabic name is as written in the Bayut blog.

chains.typical_hours_note_en: The company site and locator publish no station hours and make no 24-hour statement.
chains.notes: Locator endpoint returns 1,246 rows for the Riyadh city id with heavy duplication: 222 distinct coordinates inside the Riyadh box. Rows have coordinates and a mis-encoded Arabic address only, no station name or hours.

chains.typical_hours_note_en: The map data has no hours field and the site makes no 24-hour statement that could be loaded.
chains.notes: Open JSON map API: 839 locations nationally (stations, Naft stations, SASCO Palm shops, car washes, a hotel). 92 SASCO fuel stations inside the Riyadh box, with Arabic and English names and available fuel grades.

chains.typical_hours_note_en: No hours found for Petromin fuel stations.
chains.notes: What was found online is Petromin Express, the car-service workshop network ("800+ stations", workshop finder), not a fuel-station locator. petromin.com is a corporate site with no station list. No fuel stations captured; an OSM "Petromin" is as likely to be an oil-change workshop as a fuel station.

chains.typical_hours_note_en: No hours published.
chains.notes: Naft stations are listed inside SASCO's own station map as a separate category ("NAFT" / "نفط"), which is where the 36 Riyadh stations come from; phone given is SASCO's. naft.sa is an unrelated car-service business (NAFT OIL), not the fuel brand.

chains.typical_hours_note_en: Nothing confirmed.
chains.notes: No official website or locator could be found (liter.com.sa, liter.sa and similar did not resolve; searches returned nothing relevant). No hours and no stations.

chains.typical_hours_note_en: The operator site publishes no station hours.
chains.notes: Wafi Energy runs the Shell-branded stations in Saudi Arabia, so OSM will mostly tag them "Shell". Its service page embeds a map with 15 stations, 11 of them inside the Riyadh box. The site is English-only, so the Arabic name is not from a chain page.

general_notes.text_en: Shops are no longer required to close during the five daily prayers. A Federation of Saudi Chambers circular in mid-July 2021 said shops and commercial activities may stay open during prayer times, asking businesses to rotate staff so workers and customers can still pray. Many shops still open late on Friday (after the midday prayer, typically 13:00-14:00), which shows up in the per-branch hours here.

Opening between midnight and 05:00 needs a municipal 24-hour permit (Ministry of Municipalities and Housing, with municipality and security approval). Pharmacies, medical and educational activities, hotels and wedding halls are exempt from the permit fee; fuel stations are exempt for fuel dispensing, and for service centres outside urban areas. The permit regime does not apply in Ramadan and on holidays. So a pharmacy or fuel station being open 24 hours is the operator's choice, not a duty roster. Reported by Okaz on 4 July 2026.

No official Ministry of Health or SFDA list of on-duty or 24-hour pharmacies for Riyadh was found. Searches turned up no such MoH service (the 937 call centre is described as health advice and complaints, not a pharmacy finder). SFDA has a "list of registered pharmacies" page that search engines still index (licence registry with name, city, address, phone; no hours in the snippets), but the URL returned 404 on 2026-10-12 from two different clients. Saudi Arabia does not appear to run a rota system; 24-hour pharmacies are chain branches and hospital pharmacies.

Only Whites publishes per-branch pharmacy hours that could be read for Riyadh: 12 stores show 07:00-07:00 every day, taken as 24 hours (the site has no explicit 24-hour flag, so these are marked confidence "medium"). Lemon states "24/7" for the chain on its contact page without per-branch detail. Nahdi, Al-Dawaa, United, Kunooz and Orange 24-hour branches could not be confirmed from any official source.

danube.sa and bindawood.sa run on one platform and their store locators overlap: every Riyadh entry on bindawood.sa has the coordinates of a Danube store. Riyadh hours are therefore recorded under Danube only.
SPAR in Saudi Arabia is operated by Al Sadhan Group under a licence granted in 2016 (five Riyadh supermarkets by late 2018). The current spar.sa site lists only SPAR Express convenience outlets.

None of the fuel chains (Aldrees, SASCO, Naft, Petromin, Wafi/Shell, Liter) publishes station opening hours or a 24-hour statement on the pages that could be loaded, so no fuel hours are asserted in this file. Stations are located but hours are null. SASCO's station map also carries the Naft stations as a separate category.
Manuel Market has two Riyadh branches, Mercato Mall and Park Avenue Mall, out of 11 nationally (Argaam, 2 March 2025). No hours or coordinates were confirmed, so they are not in branches[].

The typical hours given for Nahdi, Al-Dawaa, Kunooz and United come from a single undated real-estate blog and are marked confidence "low". The same blog gives Boots Su-We 09:30-23:00 and Th-Sa 16:30-23:00, which disagrees with the Boots locator, a sign of how stale it may be.

Hours use OpenStreetMap opening_hours syntax in Riyadh local time. A closing time earlier than the opening time means past midnight (07:00-01:00 closes at 01:00 the next day). "24/7" is used only where the source shows round-the-clock opening every day. Days missing from a rule were not listed by the source.
